title: 960. Odd Even Jump

examples.explanation: Starting at values 13 and 15 reaches the final index through alternating smallest-larger and largest-smaller hops.
Three start positions can hop to the end under the odd/even rules.
Three starts succeed; the others get stuck.

hints: Process positions from right to left while keeping an ordered map from value to nearest index on the right.
For each position, the odd hop target is the ceiling entry and the even hop target is the floor entry in that map.
Track two boolean tables (can reach the end on an odd turn / on an even turn) and propagate them through the hop targets.
